import datetime as dt


def add_years(d, n):
    # Exact calendar shift; the anchor dates used here (Sep 25, Jul 28) are always valid.
    return d.replace(year=d.year + n)


# Question1: tower took 10 years and ended 2016-09-25.
end1 = dt.date(2016, 9, 25)
start1 = add_years(end1, -10)
X = start1.year
print("X (start year, Q1) =", X)

s2 = dt.date(2020, 6, 28)
j2 = dt.date(2022, 9, 28)
M = (j2.year - s2.year) * 12 + (j2.month - s2.month)
if j2.day < s2.day:
    M -= 1
Y = M
print("Y (months Jack is younger, Q2) =", Y)

# Question3: 21 years from 28-07-2018.
start3 = dt.datetime.strptime("28-07-2018", "%d-%m-%Y").date()
ready3 = add_years(start3, 21)
Z = ready3.year
print("Z (ready year, Q3) =", Z)

Xp = X + 3
Yp = Y - 22
Zp = Z - 2025
print("X' =", Xp, " Y' =", Yp, " Z' =", Zp)

# Cut-off read as date X'-Y'-Z' (year-month-day) at 18:49:42.
cutoff = dt.datetime(year=Xp, month=Yp, day=Zp, hour=18, minute=49, second=42)
print("Cut-off =", cutoff)

# Exam times, each fully specified (given times are exact; PM converted to 24h).
exams = {
    "Jason": dt.datetime(1996, 9, 23, 23, 26, 0),
    "Emma":  dt.datetime(1997, 9, 19, 19, 42, 0),
    "Joe":   dt.datetime(2050, 8, 21, 19, 51, 0),
    "Bob":   dt.datetime(1822, 9, 18, 21, 19, 0),
    "Dan":   dt.datetime(2050, 8, 21, 15, 55, 5),
}
for name in sorted(exams):
    print(name, exams[name], "BEFORE" if exams[name] < cutoff else "NOT BEFORE")

expected = sorted(n for n, t in exams.items() if t < cutoff)
print("Expected answer (persons, alphabetical) =", expected)

# Submitted answer: [1996-09-23, 1997-09-19, 1822-09-18]
submitted = [dt.date(1996, 9, 23), dt.date(1997, 9, 19), dt.date(1822, 9, 18)]

submitted_names = [date_to_name.get(d, "UNKNOWN") for d in submitted]

set_matches = sorted(submitted_names) == expected
exact_match = submitted == expected  # submitted items are dates, expected items are names
print("Same set of persons:", set_matches)
print("Submitted items are person names in alphabetical order:", exact_match)

if exact_match:
    print("CHECK PASS")
else:
    print("CHECK FAIL")
